name: Chicken Philly Cheesesteak Casserole

fit.note: 403 cal clears the 400 floor; calorie-dense build (mayo + sour cream + 8oz provolone over 6 cups chicken) so label rows are more likely to compute above 403 than below. 4.5g carb sits deep under the 35g ceiling.

dupe_check.evidence: Only Philly item in the catalog is 'philly-cheesesteak-skillet-bowls' (Ground Beef Philly Cheesesteak Bowls) - BEEF protein, rice starch, skillet method; shares only the onion+provolone flavor family (1 of 4 axes). This is whole-muscle shredded chicken, no starch base, oven-bake bound in mayo/sour-cream/provolone cream. Chicken casseroles in catalog (cordon-bleu, divan, pot-pie, hunters-bbq, loaded-potato, poppy-seed-rice) are all different flavor builds.
dupe_check.accepted_evidence: accepted-slugs carries 'philly-cheesesteak-stuffed-peppers' (BEEF, stuffed-pepper vessel) and two chicken casseroles 'jalapeno-popper-chicken-casserole' + 'hatch-green-chile-chicken-casserole' - none is a chicken philly / onion-provolone cream bake.

cross_protein_watch: Structurally this is the chicken version of the catalog's ground-beef Philly bowls and the accepted beef Philly stuffed peppers - same onion+provolone cheesesteak flavor family. Decider should watch for a TURKEY or GROUND-CHICKEN 'philly cheesesteak' casserole/bake in another selector's pool, which would be a same-dish twin. Also flag any 'chicken cheesesteak bake' variant regardless of protein string.
unmapped_note: Carries provolone-cheese flag (catalog provolone appears only in the beef philly bowls); left unmapped deliberately per v2.1 5.1 to exercise the pricer lane - not penalized.
